title: Morning Stillness & Fresh Beginnings
content:
The morning arrived with soft, cool light through the window. Started the day with black coffee and forty minutes of deep reading before the digital world began its clamor.

Reflecting on progress: clarity comes not from adding more commitments, but from stripping away what does not matter. Committed to finishing the key project milestones this week with uninterrupted focus.
